feed.title: NPR Topics: News
feed.subtitle: NPR news, audio, and podcasts. Coverage of breaking stories, national and world news, politics, business, science, technology, and extended coverage of major national and world events.

entry.title: Trump's immigration push has largely spared farms. Idaho dairymen worry it won't last.
entry.summary: America's farms have largely escaped the president's aggressive immigration crackdown. But as ICE sweeps continue across the nation, farmers are uneasy because many still can't find enough workers.

entry.title: The Trump administration weakens fuel efficiency standards for new cars
entry.summary: The Trump administration says easing these standards will make cars more affordable. Critics say it's not so simple and could be costly for the environment.

entry.title: SpaceX's Starship launches on first orbital mission from Texas
entry.summary: Starship is key to SpaceX's commercial success and NASA's plans to land humans on the moon. This is the 14th flight of the uncrewed Starship, but the first time it reached orbit.

entry.title: What we know about the suspected U.K. terror plot. And, why the Gulf remains in limbo
entry.summary: What we know — and still don't — about the suspected terror plot near a U.K. air base. Trump rejects Iran's offer to pause fighting. And CNN prepares for new owners with ties to Trump.

entry.title: Trump aims to leave a physical legacy in D.C., bulldozing norms along the way
entry.summary: President Trump has brought his New York real estate background to the White House. But experts say D.C. is a very different historic and legal landscape — and worry about the precedent he could set.

entry.title: 5 British suspects arrested, explosives found near U.S.-run air base. Iran denies role
entry.summary: Authorities have arrested five British nationals over a suspected attack at a U.S.-operated air force base in England. Iran denied involvement.

entry.title: What to know about the $810 million in spending canceled by President Trump
entry.summary: President Trump announced plans to cancel $810 million in Congressionally approved spending, a move that some in his own party are calling illegal.

entry.title: How to limit the rat numbers? Train the humans
entry.summary: D.C.'s Rat Rangers take anyone who is interested on night time safaris through some of the Capitol's filthiest back alleys to learn the way of the rats, and to be better humans.

entry.title: Schools are experimenting with AI with little evidence or policy to guide them
entry.summary: Teachers are using AI to develop lesson plans, and in some districts, AI chatbots give students feedback on their work. Meanwhile, the research around how AI can help students is extremely limited.

entry.title: 5 tips for parents worried about their kids' screen time and online safety
entry.summary: Parental monitoring can help protect kids from the harms of social media and excess screen time. Screen time boundaries plus early and open conversations about online habits can make kids less vulnerable.
